name: knell
notes: The bell's toll along the stones, 29 px tall: a polished-bronze crescent front shivering a pixel each frame, ringing bronze crests marching into it, streaks back, a glint, stone chips hopping off the floor and settling, low dust. Low: jump it. Facing +x, exported in place (12 frames @ 12 fps, seamless loop). Feet anchor: ground is canvas row 36; the front's leading edge is at canvas x 56; place that point on the ring's position.
